title: The Western Bunga of Sham Singh Is Remembered

blocks.text: A new section turns from campaigns and lineage to sacred topography in Amritsar. There existed a hospice in the west, and There used to sit S. Sham Singh in this hospice as a major Budha Dal commander whose authority reached across the city and the wider Panth.

The page then gathers the material signs of his standing. Forts, village grants, and the distribution of bungas are all associated with his name, while the later memory of the site remains strong enough that the composition of Gur Panth Prakash is linked back to his fallen establishment.
This is both memorial and institutional history. Sham Singh's bunga appears as a place where military rank, religious presence, and literary memory converge.
